architecture: Frozen MobileNetV2 alpha 0.5 + separable multiscale mask decoder
selection: minimum published-validation BCE plus soft-Dice loss; no test fitting/selection
augmentation: none for this initial cached-feature baseline
feature_cache_dtype: float16; exported backbone inference remains float32
limitations: Published clip partitions preserved; capture locations/source sequences are not established as disjoint.
Near-neighbour grayscale differences are a manual review aid, not a reliable leakage classifier.
Only sampled frames were checked for exact decoded-frame duplication.
Test partition has already been used for detector development evaluation; not an untouched safety test.
Road close-up masks cannot establish walking safety, curb/stair classes or distances.
Pixel metrics at 320x320 do not measure calibrated hazard confidence or warning-event reliability.
No representative all-negative walking clips; class specificity needs separate evaluation.
No Android runtime integration, curb/stair classes or depth estimation in this candidate.
